status: Gold-finished comparison candidate; the complete mated pair and installed cable remain unqualified

specification.resistance_test_method: ASTM B 193; do not silently assign an unstated reference temperature

limits: This cable has matching nominal pitch, circuit count and end thickness and replaces tin with gold as a candidate; that is not a manufacturer approval of the Hirose/Molex pair.
Its 0.05 µm minimum gold and 0.3 µm minimum nickel are below the 0.2 µm gold / 1–5 µm nickel example in Hirose's FPC construction guidance. Do not claim the example's exact surface stack.
The drawing permits strip length down to 3.2 mm and reinforcement down to 4 mm. Incoming parts must be measured against the chosen connector's minimum contact/support requirements.
The specification gives reinforcement tolerance ±1 mm while the newer drawing gives ±2 mm; use the wider case until the supplier resolves the discrepancy.
The 0.27 mm insulated section is thicker than the earlier 0.12 mm 15166 cable and needs a new bend/clearance check.
The flex-life result applies only to its stated manufacturer test; it is not a robot cable-life claim.
Pin mapping remains the actual installed wrist n to fanout 51−n contract and requires unpowered continuity verification.
No physical specimen or new purchasing order is represented.
